missing_methods.detailed_requirements: This method should: 1) Retrieve the current text from the feedback text edit field using get_entered_text() or similar mechanism. 2) Get the character count display text using get_feedback_text_char_count() to verify the UI shows the correct count. 3) Calculate the actual length of the entered text. 4) Assert that the text length does not exceed the expected_max_length parameter. 5) Optionally verify that the character count display matches the actual text length. 6) Return True if the text is properly truncated to the maximum character limit, False otherwise. 7) Log appropriate messages for pass/fail scenarios. This method validates that the feedback text input field enforces a maximum character limit and truncates input appropriately.
missing_methods.rationale: While feedback.py has methods to input text (input_tell_your_experience) and get character count (get_feedback_text_char_count) and retrieve entered text (get_entered_text), there is no existing method that specifically asserts or validates that the text is truncated to a maximum character limit. This validation logic belongs in feedback.py as it is directly related to the feedback form's text input behavior and character limit enforcement.
